headline.title: Musk v. Altman week 3: Musk and Altman traded blows over each other’s credibility. Now the jury will pick a side.
headline.summary: In the concluding week of the Musk v. Altman trial, attorneys challenged the credibility of both Elon Musk and OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, with Altman facing accusations of dishonesty and self-dealing. The trial has now moved to the jury phase, where they will determine the outcome based on the presented arguments.

articles.title: Good to Go: The LOOP Skill Engine That Hits 99% Success and Slashes Token Usage by 99% via One-Shot Recording and Deterministic Replay
articles.summary: The LOOP Skill Engine introduces a system that achieves a 99% success rate and reduces token usage by 99% for repetitive tasks performed by AI agents. This is accomplished through a one-shot recording and deterministic replay method, addressing the challenges posed by the stochastic nature of large language models.

articles.title: PyCSP3-Scheduling: A Scheduling Extension for PyCSP3
articles.summary: PyCSP3-Scheduling is a new extension for PyCSP3 that introduces native support for scheduling abstractions, including interval variables, sequence variables, and resource functions. This enhancement aims to improve the modeling of scheduling problems by allowing users to avoid low-level integer variables and manual channeling constraints.

articles.title: SparseOIT: Improving Order-Independent Transparency 3DGS via Active Set Method
articles.summary: The article introduces SparseOIT, a new method aimed at enhancing Order-Independent Transparency (OIT) in 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) to better handle non-lambertian and transparent materials. This approach seeks to eliminate or modify the depth sorting step traditionally used in volumetric rendering, improving the visual fidelity of rendered objects.

articles.title: CineMesh4D: Personalized 4D Whole Heart Reconstruction from Sparse Cine MRI
articles.summary: CineMesh4D presents a novel method for personalized 4D whole heart reconstruction from sparse cine MRI data, addressing the challenges of 3D cardiac anatomy sampling and the relationship between cardiac shape and motion. This approach aims to improve upon existing techniques that typically focus on reconstructing only specific cardiac chambers or phases of the cardiac cycle.

articles.title: R2R2: Robust Representation for Intensive Experience Reuse via Redundancy Reduction in Self-Predictive Learning
articles.summary: The article presents R2R2, a new regularization method designed to enhance Self-Predictive Learning (SPL) in reinforcement learning by reducing representation-level instability caused by intensive data reuse. This approach aims to improve efficiency in data-scarce domains, such as real-world robotics, while mitigating the risk of overfitting.

articles.title: PhyMotion: Structured 3D Motion Reward for Physics-Grounded Human Video Generation
articles.summary: The article introduces PhyMotion, a new approach for generating realistic human motion in video by utilizing a structured 3D motion reward system grounded in physics. This method addresses the limitations of existing reinforcement learning techniques that rely on 2D signals, aiming to improve the realism of human motion in video generation.

articles.title: LoMETab: Beyond Rank-1 Ensembles for Tabular Deep Learning
articles.summary: The article introduces LoMETab, a new approach in tabular deep learning that generalizes traditional multiplicative models to rank-$r$ ensembles, aiming to enhance performance beyond current leading methods. This development addresses the recent trend of diminishing performance differences among various tabular learning techniques, including gradient boosted decision trees and attention-based architectures.

articles.title: Video2GUI: Synthesizing Large-Scale Interaction Trajectories for Generalized GUI Agent Pretraining
articles.summary: Video2GUI is a new automated framework designed to synthesize large-scale interaction trajectories for training generalized graphical user interface (GUI) agents, addressing the limitations of existing datasets that require costly manual annotations. This approach aims to enhance the generalization capabilities of GUI agents across diverse real-world applications.

articles.title: Your CLIP has 164 dimensions of noise: Exploring the embeddings covariance eigenspectrum of contrastively pretrained vision-language transformers
articles.summary: The article explores the structural anomalies in the latent spaces of contrastively pre-trained Vision-Language Models (VLMs), identifying them as repositories for non-semantic, multi-modal noise. By employing spectral decomposition of covariance matrices, the study separates the latent space into a semantic signal component and a noise subspace, revealing insights into the noise's geometric properties.

articles.title: Sat3DGen: Comprehensive Street-Level 3D Scene Generation from Single Satellite Image
articles.summary: Researchers have introduced Sat3DGen, a method for generating comprehensive street-level 3D scenes from a single satellite image. This approach addresses the limitations of existing models by balancing geometric fidelity and semantic diversity, enabling the creation of more holistic and richly detailed urban environments.

articles.title: Pelican-Unified 1.0: A Unified Embodied Intelligence Model for Understanding, Reasoning, Imagination and Action
articles.summary: Pelican-Unified 1.0 is a novel embodied foundation model designed to integrate understanding, reasoning, imagination, and action through a unified vision-language model (VLM). This model maps various inputs, such as scenes and instructions, into a shared semantic space, enabling it to generate coherent task-oriented thought processes.
